Some difficulties were encountered in interpreting system logs and identifying the exact expected output. Although the system behavior was correctly observed, multiple similar log entries made it unclear which specific value or format should be used as the final answer.

For example, in Module 02 (Step 6: Monitor and Capture the Flag), the flag appeared to have multiple valid-looking entries, differing only in small details such as the last digits of the SUCI. This created confusion about whether a specific instance or a general pattern was expected.

This may be due to limited experience with such environments, but providing additional hints or guidance—especially for users new to this domain—could help clarify expectations and improve the learning experience.

Overall, the lab was very useful, as it helped me better understand how 5G systems operate and gave valuable insight into real-world scenarios.
